title: Sweet Sorceress
intro: Identity and packaging for a small US confectioner making premium, fully handmade chocolate-covered dragée. A little bit of magic, built to be assembled at a kitchen table.
brief: Everything at Sweet Sorceress was made by hand, packaging included, so a handful of people had to be able to assemble it quickly without driving up costs. The labels had to meet US food regulations across more than twenty flavour combinations, and the owner wanted the brand to feel whimsical: a little magical every time you treat yourself.
did: The identity is built to feel personal and a little playful instead of polished and corporate. Each flavour has its own illustration of its main ingredients, so the label tells you what's inside at a glance, with room left for the US nutrition panel, recycling marks and barcode.

The client chose stock clear jars they could buy in bulk, letting the colour of the dragée do part of the work. Everything else lives on gloss labels: quick to apply by hand, and safe from chocolate-covered fingers. For assortments, a plain kraft bag with a seal keeps the same character on an even smaller budget.
